entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The Bat God of the Night and the veil between life and death on Ixalan, eternal enemy of the Threefold Sun, imprisoned in the Core and freed after the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane on which Aclazotz is the Bat God.

entities.name: The Core
entities.description: The interior world of Ixalan where Aclazotz was trapped.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The riven star and Inner Sun that Aclazotz tries to snuff out.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: The gods who descended to defend their people against Aclazotz and are his eternal enemies.

entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: The god of fury and strength who first noticed Aclazotz, fought him, tore out one of his eyes and dragged him beyond the veil.

entities.name: Ancient One
entities.description: The ghostly spirit into which the god supplanted by Aclazotz was reborn.

entities.name: Fourth People
entities.description: A civilization in Ixalan's core before the Oltec, to which the mortal who became Aclazotz belonged.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: The people whose cities were wracked by violence from Aclazotz's cults.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: The first vampire, who learned dark rituals from Aclazotz.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: The leader of a Church of Dusk vampire expedition who freed Aclazotz.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire faction whose expedition delved into the Core and freed Aclazotz.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: The character Aclazotz decides to seek, hoping she will make better use of his power than Vito.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The forces in the Core that defeated Aclazotz's minions.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: The sun of the faith of which Aclazotz is the eternal enemy.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The destination to which Aclazotz secured passage on a Dusk Legion ship.

events.summary: A mortal of the Fourth People, afraid of death, slaughters his people, drinks their blood, and kills the final god as it emerges, becoming the bat god Aclazotz.
events.quote: As the final god emerged, he killed it and drank its divinity, becoming a horrific bat god with dominion over the border between life and death.

events.summary: Aclazotz hardens the veil between life and death into stone and whispers promises of eternal life to the terrified and bereaved.
events.quote: give yourselves to me, and you will live forever.

events.summary: Cults of Aclazotz fight back against the Komon Winaq leaders, and violence rages through their fields and cities.
events.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon Winaq raged with violence.

events.summary: Ojer Axonil battles Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes, and drags him back beyond the veil while his most faithful slip away from the Core.
events.quote: where the god of fury and strength tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and subdued him.

events.summary: Imprisoned, Aclazotz falls into a slumber.
events.quote: While imprisoned, Aclazotz fell into a slumber.

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion awakens Aclazotz, and a Church of Dusk expedition led by Vito frees him with blood sacrifices.
events.quote: He then burst free of his bindings and granted his supplicants demonic power.

events.summary: Aclazotz flies to Chimil to snuff it out, but his minions are defeated by the Sun Empire.
events.quote: However, they were defeated by the forces of the Sun Empire present in the Core.

events.summary: Aclazotz escapes to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship to find Vona.
events.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

relations.quote: He is the eternal enemy of the Threefold Sun .

relations.note: Eternal enemy of Chimil and the Deep Gods.
relations.quote: He is considered the eternal enemy of Chimil and the Deep Gods .
Ojer Axonil and Aclazotz fought in a climactic final battle
Saint Elenda of Garrano learned dark rituals from him.

relations.note: Led the expedition into the Core.
relations.quote: led by Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
Aclazotz is trapped inside the Core
